synopsis: AS ISO 16001:2020 is Australia's adoption of ISO 16001:2017, which is also published in Europe as EN ISO 16001:2017 [f2179, f2262, f2674, f15535]. The glossary identifies ISO 16001:2017 as edition 2, confirmed in 2023 [f15205]. Both Chapter 3 and the glossary state that AS ISO 16001:2020 is not law unless incorporated by a regulator or a contract [f2263, f15536]. Accordingly, ISO 16001's 300 millisecond detection limit binds an Australian quarry only when a contract or regulator requires AS ISO 16001 compliance; the supplied facts do not establish whether that condition holds for any particular quarry [f15011].
